knownLimitations: The official current Russian Post directory is office-grain. Its page advertises 61,358 records formed 2026-08-25, but the exact current archive returned HTTP 417 during this audit and a numbered relative archive returned 404. These observations do not prove non-existence.

Russian Post defines the index as a unique post-office number assigned to an address, while FIAS/GAR is an open official address register. Neither reviewed source publishes a national postal Polygon/MultiPolygon denominator.
The tariff API PDF version 3.20 advertises post-office index, hierarchy, locality and operational fields, not coordinates or area geometry.

No complete current address-to-postcode assignment plus explicit exception denominator was acquired and reconciled, and no Russian Post-compatible area processing, derivation, storage, redistribution and public-serving grant was established.

PDF signature, metadata, indexed text, pdfplumber representative-page text and Poppler renders were checked. Local PNG display failed with Windows error 206, so visual image-viewer verification is not claimed.

The first full typecheck attempt used an existing dependency tree without links for the six local @agid workspace packages and failed only on those unresolved imports. The repository tsconfig plus a temporary explicit workspace-resolution overlay then passed without source changes.
No real RU runtime, API map fit, translucent rendering or browser E2E can be exercised without an approved fixed reconciled artifact.
